headline: OpenAI releases a claimed AI-generated refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis with Lean formalization
summary: OpenAI reports that an internal model produced a refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), then released a natural-language manuscript and Lean formalization. The linked Lean scope describes a subexponential exact-counting bound for fixed-k canonical k-CNF formulas, a formalized statement that would contradict ETH if its definitions and scope match the standard conjecture. OpenAI says an external group led by Russell Impagliazzo, Ramamohan Paturi and Ryan Williams will examine the result; the group’s participation is not certification. Independent mathematical review, a reproduced build and practical algorithmic consequences remain unestablished.
